tasks.title: Fix slugify for punctuation and extra spaces
tasks.description: slugify('Hello, World!') must return 'hello-world'. Remove punctuation, turn every run of spaces or symbols into one '-', and strip '-' from both ends. Keep all other functions unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix word_count for any whitespace
tasks.description: word_count must split on ANY whitespace (spaces, tabs, new lines) and return 0 for an empty string. Keep other functions unchanged.

tasks.title: Fix truncate so the result never exceeds the limit
tasks.description: truncate(text, limit) must return at most `limit` characters. When the text is cut, the result ends with '...' and its total length is exactly `limit`. Short text is returned unchanged.

tasks.title: Add is_palindrome
tasks.description: Add is_palindrome(text). It must ignore case and punctuation. Reuse slugify() to normalise the text. Keep other functions unchanged.
